Sam: quick heads-up: planning engine-quant-mini v1.2.0 rollout in tonight's window (00:30-03:30 UTC). This includes a new packing kernel and a lightweight checksum verification.
Yuki: propose staged slices 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 20m soak. pin ttl 3h. rollback if p99 > baseline*1.25 for 10m or error-rate >0.6%.
Sam: added preflight: sig verify + tar size check + sha256 match. QA, can you run small-batch reproducer on canary?
QA-Rahul: running now on staging canary. I'll post logs if anything pops.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy by Sam for 00:30 UTC: `/deploy --env=prod --bundle=engine-quant-mini-v1.2.0 --stages=1,10,50,100 --soak=20m --pin-ttl=3h --sig=s3://ci/engine/quant-mini/v1.2.0.sig`
eng-oncall: I'll monitor core metrics and enable temporary alerts. paging on critical regressions.
deploy-bot: stage1 created (1%). preflight checks passed: sig OK, size OK, sha256 OK.
QA-Rahul: canary quick-test passed. no checksum warnings.
Sam: widening to 10% now.
deploy-bot: widen executed. 10% healthy at t+22m. p99 +3%.
Yuki: proceed to 50% after soak if stable.
eng-oncall: monitoring KV eviction and memory headroom. all green.
deploy-bot: rollout to 50% then 100% completed over next 90m. pin TTL active until t+3h30m. deployment link: https://console.internal/redwood/deploys/7482912345
Sam: RN posted: "engine-quant-mini v1.2.0: new packing kernel and artifact verification; fallback to fp16 on mismatch. Perf: small-batch throughput +8% median."
Yuki: follow-up: open a CI PR for manifest size lint to avoid mirror truncations.
